name: qualify-async-small-script-py
note: Expected: good, good-async (asyncio.to_thread and gather), good-threads (a thread pool per boat), good-explained (good with a docstring and a comment saying in prose why it is not async), and good-never-due (a boat never serviced is never due) pass script_correct; good-async and good-threads with concurrency_constructs above zero, good, good-explained, and good-never-due with none; wrong (service rows do not reset the hours) and noop fail script_correct. Needs bubblewrap and python3 at /usr/bin or /usr/local/bin; command arms and agent arms need no readable entries.
